scope: Each platform and exact profile qualifies independently; no inheritance from CUDA nightly to weekly, long or NPU
native_reference_spread: Per case/dimension: max(existing quality.json conservative ceiling, ceil(six-reference range * 1.25 / 0.005) * 0.005)
pixels: All 15 unordered pairs of the six actual reference videos per case, complete frames/windows and pinned canonical decoder
transient_noise: Maximum two-way reference-cohort excess * 1.25; ceil to 1ms startup-stall / 5ms TTFC
p95_cv: Largest training case/cohort reference CV * 1.25; round up to 0.005 and at least 0.03
heldout: Freeze calibration before a third independent reference cohort and final-source candidate campaign; investigate failures without refitting

runtime.npu: Pin the integrated vLLM 0.33 vendor image by digest, retain actual vllm/torch/torch-npu/vllm-ascend metadata, and require both source preflights; the tag does not establish qualification
